Fukashigi Nijimura (虹村ふかしぎ - Niji-mura fukashigi) is an ally in the light novel JORGE JOESTAR from the 37th universe. He is a Stand User who wields the Stand NYPD Blue, and is the twin brother of Muryotaisu Nijimura.

page.overview:
Who is Fukashigi Nijimura?

Fukashigi Nijimura (虹村ふかしぎ - Niji-mura fukashigi) is an ally in the light novel JORGE JOESTAR from the 37th universe. He is a Stand User who wields the Stand NYPD Blue, and is the twin brother of Muryotaisu Nijimura.

He is an ally of Joji Joestar and helps him search for Yoshikage Kira along with Koji Hirose. He is the one of the alternates of the Nijimura Brothers from the original universe after their world had been reset thirty-six times by Made In Heaven.

Fukashigi acts similarly to Okuyasu Nijimura (from the original universe) and seems to be very short-tempered after attempting to attack Joji without a proper introduction.

Though, he is very willing to avenge his friends after being murdered by Kira and is brave enough to fend off of the gang members from Nero Nero Island.
